title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1024 | 百年新猫、变色虾眼、深海巨虫
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🐱 时隔一百多年，科学家在玻利维亚云雾森林里认出一种全新小野猫，浅棕毛上长满玫瑰花斑点！
🦐 螳螂虾的眼睛像电灯开关，能看到我们想象不到的颜色，一开一关切换自如！
🪲 一只来自波多黎各的深海巨虫在德国博物馆抽屉里躺了几十年，挂错名牌后终于被认出是新物种！

📖 Word of the day: rosette（玫瑰斑点）

🎮 二选一：想要能看到秘密颜色的螳螂虾眼睛，还是像新小猫一样满身玫瑰斑点的外套？快和爸爸妈妈一起选边站！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🐱 After more than one hundred years, scientists recognize a brand new tiny wild cat in Bolivia's cloud forests, with light brown fur covered in rosettes!
🦐 A mantis shrimp's eyes work like a light switch, seeing colors we cannot even imagine!
🪲 A giant isopod from Puerto Rico sat in a German museum drawer for decades under the wrong name before scientists recognized it as a new species!

📖 Word of the day: rosette

🎮 Would you rather have mantis shrimp eyes that can see secret colors, or a coat covered in rosettes like the tiny new cat?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. rosette（玫瑰斑点）
a spot shaped like a little rose
例：a coat covered in rosettes（一身玫瑰斑点）

2. colossal（巨大的）
really, really big
例：a colossal giant（超级大块头）

3. isopod（深海巨虫）
a sea animal with a hard shell that looks like a giant woodlouse
例：a giant isopod（一只深海巨虫）

4. cloud forest（云雾森林）
a forest high up where clouds drift through the trees
例：in the cloud forest（在云雾森林里）
